delmas_64_g1.label: Delmas G1 (64 trials)

definition.contrast: known minus unknown, within trials containing exactly one known face, per participant mean over presentations; d_z = mean/SD of the participant contrasts

stored_phase2_per_second_ablation.source: results/phase2/preti/comparison_card.md section 4a (pupil + blinks per second, fitted model, repeat-mean AUC)

definition.rule: Nadeau-Bengio corrected variance (1/J + n_test/n_train) s^2 over the J = repeats x folds per-fold differences, t with J-1 df; naive 1/J shown next to it; across-repeat t (R-1 df) as a conservative check
definition.note: per-fold metric = AUC of the fold's decision units (person AUC; Delmas image AUC per set); single-class folds dropped; Chen = per-fold detection rate
definition.mazza_repeats: baseline files hold 3 repeats, the unified run 5; only the 3 common repeats enter

chen_detection_unified_minus_rate_rule.metric: per-fold detection rate difference (fraction of the fold's familiar participants detected at the calibrated FPR<=7% threshold)

chen_detection_I2b_minus_rate_rule.metric: per-fold detection rate difference (fraction of the fold's familiar participants detected at the calibrated FPR<=7% threshold)

definition.note: SEs condition on the fitted models (no refit variance), so MDEs are lower bounds and powers upper bounds

delmas_noninferiority.note: mean over six group-sets of the image-level AUC (G3 appears twice, as in the pre-registered primary); rank transform within repeat and set

chen_person_auc.note: AUC analogue of the Chen primary (detection at FPR <= 7% has no AUC): person z statistic, familiar vs control-1 and control-2 (pre-registered pooling), rate rule as baseline

chen_trial_auc.note: descriptive: trial-level AUC, familiar vs control trials, rate rule as baseline
